sloka: पुनर्दृष्ट्वा च वैदेहीं विसृष्टश्च तया पुनः ।। ५.५८.१६३ ।।।।
transliteration: punardṛṣṭvā ca vaidehīṁ visṛṣṭaśca tayā punaḥ ।। 5.58.163 ।।।।

translations.english: After seeing Vaidehi once more and being dismissed by her again, I reached Mount Arishta and, longing to see you all, leapt up to return.
